description:
A market snapshot of the workspace's website from an external index of AI answers: ChatGPT's and Gemini's answers to the brand's buyer questions as users see them in its country (share of answers naming the brand and each competitor, who else they name, which sources they cite), and how often Google's AI Overviews cite the site next to its competitors, month by month, with the questions where a competitor is cited and the site is not.

Use this tool when the user asks how visible they are in AI before their own questions are tracked, or wants the wider market picture next to their own tracking -- phrases like 'does ChatGPT recommend us', 'who does AI recommend instead of us', 'how do we compare in Google's AI answers'.

The snapshot is built once, when the account is created; status 'building' means it is not ready yet. Its numbers are not the workspace's own tracking: read each section's about.

Example question: 'Does ChatGPT recommend Kassaro?'
